E0957

`embed_file`/`embed_bytes` path or `find` glob not a literal, absolute, or escaping via `..`

What

`embed_file`/`embed_bytes` path or `find` glob not a literal, absolute, or escaping via `..`

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0957

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0957: tests/ui/comptime_embed_absolute.stderr.

Error [E0957]: `embed_file` path must be relative
  --> tests/ui/comptime_embed_absolute.jet:1:7
    |
  1 | @d :: embed_file("/etc/passwd")
    |       ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: an absolute path reaches outside the project
 Fix: use a path relative to this file's own directory
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0957

Error [E0107]: nothing named `@d` exists here
  --> tests/ui/comptime_embed_absolute.jet:4:13
    |
  4 |     print("{@d}")
    |             ^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `@d :: ...`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0107
